product_one_liner.value: Neostella provides connected legal case-management software that unifies cases, workflows, data, and legal tools for modern law firms and legal teams.
product_one_liner.notes: Company describes its platform as enterprise legal case-management software.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists $175 per user/month plus add-on pricing.

named_customers.notes: Named customer evidence found for Groth Law Firm and a customer testimonial quoted in the launch announcement, but that second customer's name was not available in the sourced text. The value includes the verified name only rather than guessing.

employee_band.notes: About page states 250+ globally; GetLatka reports 385 employees.

hq_location.notes: Milwaukee is the company headquarters. Chicago is identified separately as its go-to-market headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company's About page and GetLatka profile state 2019.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog is marketing/editorial content; no qualifying pair of engineering-authored product-build posts was found. A third-party API case study is not an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Public help center contains multiple help categories and technical reference articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The accessible company job board lists roles such as Product Support Specialist, DevOps Engineer, Marketing Generalist, and Implementation Support Specialist; none is an AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Neostella says firms can connect their preferred external AI tools, but no particular model or provider was publicly identified in the product material reviewed.

compliance_certs.notes: The company announced SOC 2 Type II certification. No other listed certification was included.

last_funding.notes: A round is listed, and Tracxn reports $10.7M raised in one early-stage round. Crunchbase masks the round date and amount, so exact date and round amount cannot be confirmed. The schema requires a YYYY-MM date and numeric USD amount; these are left empty/zero rather than inferred.

raised_18mo.notes: Funding history exists, but the round date is obfuscated in the accessible round record, so whether it falls within the 18-month window cannot be established.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Search results showed Neostella Account Executive and Sales Development Representative listings; the company-hosted Workable board was checked, though its page did not return readable details.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest clear product launch located was the connected legal case-management platform announcement dated December 4, 2025, before the six-month window. 2026 news includes conference announcements and customer-experience improvements rather than a product launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The VP of Product profile shows Brian Mayer in that role from December 2025, within the past 12 months.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Neostella's product/integration material identifies Lawmatics as a CRM for law firms.
